# code-mc
Write python inside of minecraft to control the world as a developer.
Updates and source code coming soon!
Inspired by computer craft.
Please join our [our discord](https://discord.gg/Gg4eSBMYre)!

Note: Highly experimental! More to come!

# Video Demonstration

# Usage
Open in-game chat and click the top left button that says "xos viewport". Next, click "files" in the bottom left of the screen, and select a script you want to read/run. Now, click the green button in the bottom left to execute the script.

There are 3 buttons, files, viewport, and terminal for navigation, you can swap between those tabs to see if there were any pixel outputs.

More examples and advanced coding features coming soon, including an AI code generator!

For news and updates on developments, please join our discord!

# Technical Details

Built for Forge 47.4.3 on Minecraft 1.20.1 and Java 17 (will update as development continues).
